The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Root cause: the divide-by-zero flag used the live `divisor` input instead of the captured `dvs` register, and `abort` wasn't checked on the final iteration, so it couldn't cancel a division that was about to complete. Both are now fixed in `rtl/div_seq.v`.
